items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: Do you remember Ed Burke or Bradley Bullock? They were trombone players with Walter Bond? I don't know.

ctx.x: Mostly tenor. Every time I seen him, he was playing sax.
Do you remember Ed Burke or Bradley Bullock? They were trombone players with Walter Bond? I don't know. What about, uh, Lucius Wilson? He played tenor.
